title: TurboDL Plugin Manifest
description: Machine-readable descriptor placed at the root of a TurboDL plugin repository.

id.description: Must equal the plugin's Plugin.id. Lowercase, dot-separated <category>.<name>.

category.description: Which shelf the plugin sits on. turbodl-protocol is for a plugin that declares the protocols/schemes it handles (the `protocols` field; it may also implement a DownloadBackend); turbodl-backend is for a plugin whose identity is implementing a backend; turbodl-loader is for a plugin that loads plugins written in another language.

capabilities.description: Capability ids this plugin provides, in namespaced form <namespace>.cap.<name> (the TurboDL project's own namespace is dev.turbodl.cap.*, e.g. dev.turbodl.cap.hls). The namespace keeps two vendors' same-named capabilities from colliding. A capability is a market/diagnostics label only: it grants NO permission and changes no behavior. Legacy bare strings such as turbodl-hls (or turbodl-parser) do NOT match and are rejected; capability GitHub topics keep the turbodl-* spelling (see MARKET.md).

protocols.description: Protocols/schemes this plugin declares it can handle, e.g. ["hls"], ["magnet","bt","ed2k"], ["ftp","sftp","webdavs"]. One plugin MAY declare several: the ecosystem model is one plugin for many protocols, not one plugin per protocol. The host builds a load-time scheme -> plugin index from these declarations (host.protocols), used for discovery, market filtering, diagnostics and conflict reporting. A declaration grants NO permission and does not by itself route downloads: a DownloadBackend (see extensionPoints) still decides what handles a request. Names are lowercase URL-scheme-like tokens; note a content type is not a URL scheme (an .m3u8 URL's scheme is http(s)), so declare the name the market should know the plugin by.

language.description: kotlin for a JVM plugin class, js for a script loaded by turbo-plugin-js.

pluginClass.description: Fully-qualified Plugin implementation class (kotlin), or script entry (js).

coordinates.description: Maven coordinates when type=maven, e.g. group:artifact:version.

extensionPoints.description: Extension-point ids this plugin registers, e.g. turbo.downloadBackend.
